verdict.rationale: Auto Drafts 2.0 can pull from your calendar and "insert availability" into replies, and you can give scheduling features plain-language instructions such as "use this booking link". Together these suggest availability and booking links can end up in emails, but only through AI-generated drafts rather than a documented direct insert action. Missing for 10: a documented user-invoked command to insert availability or bookable time slots into a compose window, details on how the inserted times are formatted or made bookable, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
